question: How is the śākta dimension characterized in relation to extraction of those constituents?
premises: Extraction and related operations concern those constituents
The śākta dimension is connected with these operations
This śākta dimension is eight-fold and forceful
inference: The śākta level is defined as an eight-fold forceful process involving extraction of those constituents
plain_english: Joined with their extraction and so forth, the śākta dimension is eight-fold and operates forcibly.
